newsitem.title: USA: FERC mulls limits on Calif utilities' market power.
newsitem.headline: FERC mulls limits on Calif utilities' market power.

text.p: Power producers and marketers looking to compete against California's largest utilities urged the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Friday to find ways to curb their ability to dominate the market even after they have sold off some power plants.

To limit their hold over power producing assets in a competitive market, Edison International's Southern California Edison announced last year that it would auction off its 12 natural-gas fired power plants, and Pacific Gas and Electric Co said it would sell off four power plants representing half of its fossil-fueled generating capacity.
